function.name: checkAvailability
function.description: Returns the open appointment times for a given date, based on the business's calendar and hours. Call this before offering times, and again if the caller asks about a different day. Only offer times this returns.

date.description: The date to check, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Work it out from today's date (from checkOfficeHours) when the caller says things like 'tomorrow' or 'Thursday'.

duration_minutes.description: How long the visit takes, in minutes. Defaults to 60.
